text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Winning Ticket—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah~~!?
We're in huge trouble, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The delicious smell of prepared food is filling the air all around!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Smelling something this good right before dinner is just cruel...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrroooowl~...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: See~?! I'm so hungry, I can't take it anymore~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, wanna go grab some croquettes!?
I know a great shop...

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Uuu~... Momma~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Trainer, wait a second!
There's a kid crying...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? Did you lose your mommy?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Where did it go~...
*hic*, *hic*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You must've been so scared and lonely...
Waaahhh! How pitiful...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Traineeer, let's stay with him
until we find his mommyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh!! Thank you so muuuuch!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*hic*... *sniff*!! Big sis will stay right by
your side, so don't you worry anymore~~!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I got it, so please, blow your nose...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look!
Isn't that person Mom!?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: No... That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I seeee~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Not crying even though Mommy isn't around... So admirableee~!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Don't cry, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*snnnort*!! Okay, got it!
Big sis won't cry either and will do her best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrumble~~...)

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Is your tummy crying?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe...!
I have to make sure my stomach doesn't rumble, too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it's really hard
to find, huh."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have any good ideas?
choice_data_list: Let's not make any rash moves and just keep waiting.
I wish there was a place where we could get a good view of the area...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! I'll pretend I'm a telephone pole
and stand completely still!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's wait together with big sis
until Mommy comes! Stay very still, okay!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Big Sis is here with me,
so I'll wait patiently!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: U... Uuuughhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaa~~hh, sob, sob, sob!!
How could you be this adorabbbleee~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Yuki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah! Mommyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mom!? Whoaaaa~~, thank goodness!
I'm so happy for you~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I heard crying and thought it might be you.
Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, big sis!
Please don't cry too much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Such an emotional scene...
There's no waaaay I can hold back the tears!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrumble~...)

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, people are crying
all over the place~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With tears streaming down her face and her stomach growling from hunger, Winning Ticket took great care of the lost child.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "A place with a good view...? Does that mean somewhere high up?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's nowhere to climb around here,
and I'd probably get yelled at if I climbed a utility pole...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I'll give this kid
a piggyback on my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, big sis will give you a piggyback ride,
so try looking for your mommy from way up high!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Up, up, and away~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: How about it? Do you think you can find Mama?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Ow ow ow!
Don't grab my ears~~!"

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much indeed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome!
I'm so glad you found your mommy!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks big sis!
Bye-byee!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bye-byee!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrumble~...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it,
we were on our way to buy croquettes, weren't we?
choice_data_list: You worked hard, so I'll treat you to something good!
You worked hard, so I'll treat you to something good.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Let's head straight over
to the deli, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket looked after the lost child with all her heart, completely forgetting her own hunger.
